ASS00650 is a specific laboratory database code used to identify measurements of p-thyrotropin, commonly known as thyroid-stimulating hormone [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's "Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark" (AFDK) program, this code is a fundamental component of quality indicator 3 [^src1]. It is utilized in national registry analyses to systematically identify and track laboratory tests related to the diagnosis and clinical management of patients with atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The code is listed alongside various other NPU, DNK, and ASS identifiers that collectively enable standardized data extraction for monitoring treatment quality and clinical outcomes across Danish health registries [^src1].
